description: On the red bedspread in front of you, there’s a small white blocky chair-like structure made of interlocking pieces. The left hand stays on the left side of the structure to steady it as the right hand moves in from the right, pinches a small white block on the right side, pulls it straight out to the right, and sets that removed piece down on the bed beside the chair (the structure is a left-hand object, and the small block becomes a right-hand object before being released).
